items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 16 August 2026 6:18am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Nil.

##State of sea)##

##Weather)##

Mainly fair, risk of isolated rain at times.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in any rain.


##Temperature##

16°C
